cards.title: Order of events
cards.idea: Dates let us put events in the correct order, so we know what happened before and what came after.

interaction.prompt: Drag these three events into the order they happened: India becomes independent (1947), the first railway runs in India (1853), the Constitution comes into force (1950)

cards.reveal: Correct order: 1853, 1947, 1950. Without dates you could not tell which came first.

cards.title: Cause and effect
cards.idea: Knowing the order of events helps us see how one event may have led to another.

interaction.prompt: Tap the event that came first: the freedom struggle grew (before 1947) or India became independent (1947)

cards.reveal: The freedom struggle came first. A cause must happen before its effect, so dates help us test whether one event could have caused another.

cards.title: The timeline
cards.idea: A timeline is a line marked with dates, used to place events at their correct spots and see the gaps between them.

interaction.prompt: Tap the point on the timeline where 1947 should sit, between 1900 and 2000

cards.reveal: 1947 sits just under halfway between 1900 and 2000. A timeline shows both order and the distance in years between events.

cards.title: BCE and CE
cards.idea: Years are counted from a fixed point. Years before it are labelled BCE and years after it are labelled CE, and BCE years count backwards.

interaction.prompt: Tap the earlier year: 300 BCE or 100 CE

cards.reveal: 300 BCE is earlier. BCE years get smaller as time moves forward, so 300 BCE comes long before 100 CE.

cards.title: Sources decide dates
cards.idea: Historians work out dates from evidence like inscriptions, coins and old writings, so a date is a careful conclusion, not a guess.

interaction.prompt: Type one source a historian could use to fix the date of an old event

cards.reveal: Inscriptions, coins, monuments and written records all carry clues that help historians date events.

workbook.prompt: Why do dates matter in history
options: They let us place events in the correct order
They make history harder to read
They replace the need for any evidence
workbook.answer: They let us place events in the correct order

workbook.prompt: A line marked with years, used to show events in order, is called a ________.

boss.prompt: An event in 400 BCE and an event in 200 BCE both happened. Which is correct
options: They happened in the same year

boss.prompt: A historian claims a war in 1850 was caused by a treaty signed in 1870. Why must this claim be wrong
options: A cause must come before its effect, but 1870 is after 1850
boss.answer: A cause must come before its effect, but 1870 is after 1850

boss.prompt: How many years passed between an event in 500 BCE and an event in 300 CE? Answer in years: ________.
